description: Links a protein subunit to the complex of which it is a member. Protein endpoints represent base UniProt accessions; source-specific isoform or mature-chain accessions are retained in edge properties. Complexes with the same set of base protein members share a Complex node, including stoichiometric or assembly variants.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was created or last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Experimentally characterized human protein complexes, including single-subunit complexes. Only complexes whose base protein members are all represented in SPOKE are included.
source_contributions.description: Provides membership relationships from the CORUM catalog of mammalian protein complexes.

properties.name: corum_subunit_accessions
properties.description: Original isoform or mature-chain accessions identifying this subunit in CORUM; absent when the source gives a plain base accession.

source_contributions.scope: Curated Complex Portal complexes across species represented by Organism nodes in SPOKE; the ML-predicted complexes file is excluded. Membership represents protein participants only, excluding chemical, nested-complex, RNAcentral, and IntAct-internal identifiers. Complexes containing alternative-accession groups, no protein members, or any protein member absent from SPOKE are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Provides protein membership from IntAct Complex Portal. Stoichiometry is not stored.

properties.name: intact_subunit_accessions
properties.description: Original isoform or mature-chain accessions identifying this subunit in IntAct, with stoichiometry removed; absent when the source gives a plain base accession.
